notes.text: 정직한 오류나 견해 차이는 연구부정행위에 포함되지 않음

source: ORI Definition of Research Misconduct (ori.hhs.gov/definition-misconduct): "Fabrication is making up data or results and recording or reporting them"; falsification = manipulating research materials, equipment, or processes (or changing/omitting data); "does not include honest error or differences of opinion".
